features.text: THERAPY FOR SEVERE CONTRACTURES: Addresses moderate to severe hand and wrist contractures and stiffness.
BEND-TO-FIT TECHNOLOGY: Allows clinicians or caregivers to reshape the orthosis without tools.
PALMAR ROLL PROGRESSION: Gradually increases joint extension for long-term rehabilitation.
COLOR-CODED STRAPS: Provide intuitive setup and consistent fit during daily use.
DURABLE REHAB CONSTRUCTION: Built for prolonged therapy sessions with lightweight comfort.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Moderate to severe wrist, hand, and finger contractures
Radial or ulnar deviation of the hand
